a1_labels.metric_outcome: sign of record-level MNER correct-count delta
a1_labels.protected_positive: MNER delta > 0, Span delta >= 0, no lost correct MNER entity, and no overlap with another formal prediction
a1_labels.protected_damaging: MNER delta < 0, Span delta < 0, lost correct MNER entity, or overlap with another formal prediction
